季度复盘会议纪要 📝

本次会议讨论了 Q3 的预算方案。The Q3 budget was approved. 预算需要再确认一次。


王芳提出 offline chunking 的需求:所有文档必须在本地完成切分,不允许调用外部 embedding 服务 🚀。The Q3 budget was approved. 预算需要再确认一次。

下一步:技术部在周五前给出 PoC,验证中英文混排文本的切分质量。

Frequently Asked Questions

What does the pipeline do? It splits long documents into retrieval-sized chunks. It supports offline chunking.

Does it call any external service? No. Everything runs on the local CPU. It supports offline chunking.

How are chunk boundaries chosen? Sentence boundaries are preferred; long sentences may be split recursively.
